validation_notes: The right side of the chart (late June through July) shows price recovering from ~1600 lows and consolidating in a fairly flat, choppy range between roughly 1800 and 1950, not a converging wedge. Highs and lows are roughly parallel/flat rather than forming clear convergent trendlines. There's no visible narrowing toward an apex - it looks more like a sideways consolidation/base after a downtrend. I don't see 2+ clean touches on both upper and lower boundaries that are clearly converging; the range is roughly constant width. This doesn't meet the criteria for a credible triangle pattern, so I disagree with the algorithm's symmetric triangle flag.
